Let me analyze the requirements:

1. There are 5 pumps, each with priority, selection, and RunComd fields
2. Mode determines manual (FALSE) or automatic (TRUE) operation
3. Manual mode: control pumps based on pumpGroup[1..5].selection
4. Automatic mode: select top 3 pumps by priority (three in use, two on standby)
5. Start button starts selected pumps, stop button stops all pumps

The function block needs to:
- Read mode, start, stop inputs
- Read pumpGroup (priority and selection)
- Write to pumpGroup.RunComd

Let me implement this in Structured Text for CODESYS 3.5:

```structured-text
FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_MultiPumpControl
VAR_INPUT
    mode : BOOL;        // FALSE: Manual, TRUE: Automatic
    start : BOOL;       // Start button
    stop : BOOL;        // Stop button
END_VAR

VAR_IN_OUT
    pumpGroup : ARRAY[1..5] OF ST_Pump;
END_VAR

VAR
    lastStart : BOOL;
    lastStop : BOOL;
    edgeStart : BOOL;
    edgeStop : BOOL;
END_VAR

// Edge detection for start and stop buttons
edgeStart := start AND NOT lastStart;
edgeStop := stop AND NOT lastStop;
lastStart := start;
lastStop := stop;

// Main logic
IF stop THEN
    // Stop all pumps
    FOR i := 1 TO 5 DO
        pumpGroup[i].RunComd := FALSE;
    END_FOR;
ELSIF start THEN
    // Start pumps based on mode
    IF mode = FALSE THEN
        // Manual mode - run pumps where selection is TRUE
        FOR i := 1 TO 5 DO
            pumpGroup[i].RunComd := pumpGroup[i].selection;
        END_FOR;
    ELSE
        // Automatic mode - select top 3 by priority
        // Need to sort or find top 3
    END_IF;
END_IF;
```
